plugins.name: cantrips
plugins.description: The core engineering loop for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI): grill, spec, tickets, implement with TDD at agreed seams, review, commit, plus a user-gated compound step that turns session learnings into durable project memory. Basic spells a caster always has prepared.

plugins.name: wards
plugins.description: Style guard for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI): a language-agnostic code style skill loaded before writing code, plus a line-length hook that flags overlong lines right after an edit. Protective spells that trigger at a boundary.

plugins.name: typescript
plugins.description: TypeScript code style for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI): strict compiler settings, nullability discipline, readonly data, and assertion-based type guards, loaded before writing or editing TypeScript.
